item.title: [Desktop] Web3
item.description:
• Added “Verified” DApp status to wallet connection panels. (#45507)
  • Added “Connections” tab in the wallet panel for concurrent connections between “EVM” and “SVM” networks. (#41564)
  • Added “Reset ZCash sync state” setting under brave://settings/web3. (#44782)
  • Added Zcash shielded support on the “Deposit” screen. (#45185)
  • Implemented auto-hide for bottom sheet when clicking away from the wallet panel. (#45436)
  • Updated default segmented control size in wallet panel. (#45351)
  • Fixed issue where Zcash native token may not be displayed on some wallets. (#46306)
  • Fixed the “More” menu on the “Accounts” list being pushed out of view in certain cases. (#44949)

item.title: [Desktop] Leo
item.description:
• Added “DeepSeek R1” to the list of pre-loaded models. (#45294)
  • Added the ability to have links in Leo responses. (#44207)
  • Added support for inline citations in generated responses. (#45152)
  • Added full page screenshot feature for Brave Leo. (#45510)
  • Added support for HTTPS links in responses when using Bring Your Own Model (BYOM) in Brave Leo. (#45116)
  • Added support to allow for empty favicon for WebSources. (#45346)
  • Updated Leo toolbar icon to launch full page chat. (#44988)
  • Updated chat bubbles to break and wrap long words and URLs. (#45302)

item.title: [Desktop] General
item.description:
• [Security] Fixed Tor onion icon incorrectly appearing in the URL bar in certain cases as reported on HackerOne by newfunction. (#45102 & #45376)
  • Improved formatting of version information under brave://settings/help. (#2560)
  • Updated the UI for Progressive Web Apps (PWAs) for Windows and Linux. (#45107)
  • Updated download button icon. (#45239)
  • Removed “Can’t update Brave” message from hamburger menu on macOS. (#37427)
  • Fixed issue with WebSocket reconnection. (#15410)
  • Fixed Brave and Chromium versions displaying as “undefined” in brave://settings/help when browser language is not English. (#45840)
  • Upgraded Chromium to 137.0.7151.61. (#46422) (Changelog for 137.0.7151.61)

item.title: [Android] General
item.description:
• Added inline PDF viewer to open PDF files directly in Brave. (#42621)
  • Added ability to enable bottom address bar via brave://flags. (#41699)
  • Removed Chromium search widgets from Brave. (#45598 & #30653)
  • Removed Chromium Dino game widget from Brave. (#30654)
  • Fixed PiP (Picture-in-Picture) functionality to work properly when Brave is backgrounded or when device is locked and unlocked. (#44933 & #46128)
  • Fixed crash which occurred when using search functionality in certain cases. (#45127)
  • Upgraded Chromium to 137.0.7151.61. (#46422) (Changelog for 137.0.7151.61)

item.title: [iOS] Release Notes v1.78.104 (May 21, 2025)
item.description:
• Fixed script blocking affecting other websites when enabled in shields panel for particular webpage. (#46155)
  • Fixed page zoom having no effect on the webpage when active. (#46200)

item.title: [iOS] Release Notes v1.78.103 (May 16, 2025)
item.description:
• Implemented Picture-in-Picture animation when setting default browser in the onboarding flow. (#44182)
  • Added new custom app icon designs. (#44587)
  • Added localization enhancements to the default browser onboarding animation for UK and Japan users. (#44183)
  • Added shuffle button to the Brave Playlist player in CarPlay. (#43691)
  • Added page loading indicator to the VPN region selection screen. (#45371)
  • Added privacy warning dialog when submitting Leo chat feedback. (#45947)
  • Re-enabled toggle visibility for “Block All Cookies” setting and also moved it into “Other Privacy Settings”. (#45457)
  • Removed dialog from being displayed for successfully exporting bookmarks. (#44654)
  • Improved support for downloading bundled Apple Wallet passes. (#43338)
  • Improved Leo chat operations by increasing the limit for associated content length in responses. (#43928)
  • Improved Playlist video downloading with an additional background fallback method. (#44652)
  • [Security] Fixed issue where file extensions for downloaded files are being hidden as reported on HackerOne by b4dc4t. (#45433)
  • [Security] Fixed issue with Tel: protocol prompts showing other origin as reported on HackerOne by frozzipies. (#44719)
  • [Security] Fixed links not opening in a private tab when using private browsing mode. (#45389)
  • Fixed “Block Scripts” and “Block Fingerprinting” toggle being shown as disabled after toggling Brave Shields. (#43968)
  • Fixed VPN not enabling in the case where the server is manually selected from the list. (#45370)
  • Fixed VPN server country not being updated after connecting. (#45364)
  • Fixed VPN connection status not displaying correctly in region selection screen. (#45365)
  • Fixed P3A onboarding page content from being clipped when using accessibility zoom. (#44646)
  • Fixed videos with non-Latin characters failing to save offline in Playlist. (#42764)
  • Upgraded Chromium to 136.0.7103.113. (#46065)(Changelog for 136.0.7103.113)
